serves 4Thick airy dough baked in an oiled tin with cheese right to the edges for lacy crisp corners, pepperoni underneath and rich tomato sauce striped on top.Mix 400g bread flour, 300ml warm water, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil into a wet dough and prove 2 hours.Press into a well-oiled 23 by 33cm tin and prove 30 minutes.Lay 100g pepperoni over, then 350g cubed mozzarella and cheddar Serve with a bag of fairy floss.Theme park churros with chocolate dipAxel, are you on a coffee break?How to make itAs written, serves 4Choux dough piped in long ridged lengths, fried crisp and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick hot chocolate dipping sauce.Bring 250ml water, 50g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour, cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs.Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180°C and fry 3 minutes until golden.Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.Heat 150ml cream until steaming and stir in 150g dark chocolate for the dip.DrinksWonder World blue raspberry slushieBlue raspberry syrup blitzed with lemonade, lime and plenty of ice until slushy, poured tall with a striped straw and a few frozen raspberries.How to make it120ml blue raspberry cordial400ml lemonade1 lime4 cups of ice40g frozen raspberriesBlitz the cordial, lemonade, lime juice and ice in short bursts until fine and slushy.Drop frozen raspberries into tall glasses.Pour the slushie over and serve with straws straight away.
